// WallpaperWindow.qml — wallpapers kiezen, previewen, toevoegen en verwijderen.
//
// Het venster toont alle wallpapers die scripts/wallpaper-theme.sh kent:
// ~/Pictures/wallpaper.jpg en ~/Pictures/Wallpapers/. Klikken selecteert een
// wallpaper en toont hem groot rechts; dubbelklikken of “Toepassen” zet hem
// met het themascript (feh + matugen + BSPWM + GTK + alacritty + rofi).
//
// “Toevoegen” opent een ingebouwde bestandsbrowser. Die werkt zonder zenity of
// een desktop-portal: mappen worden met `find` gelezen, afbeeldingen direct
// gepreviewd en pas bij “Toevoegen” naar de wallpapermappen gekopieerd.
//
// Als FloatingWindow krijgt het venster onder X11 toetsenbordfocus, zodat het
// padveld en Escape werken.

import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import "../theme"
import "../services"

FloatingWindow {
    id: win

    title: "Wallpapers"
    implicitWidth: 1120
    implicitHeight: 760
    minimumSize: Qt.size(880, 600)
    color: Theme.base
    visible: false

    property string selectedPath: ""
    property string statusMessage: ""
    property string confirmDeletePath: ""

    // --- Bestandsbrowser ---------------------------------------------------

    property bool pickerOpen: false
    property string pickerPath: Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/Pictures"
    property string pickerDraftPath: win.pickerPath
    property var pickerEntries: []
    property string pickerSelected: ""
    property bool pickerScanning: false
    property string pickerError: ""

    readonly property string home: Quickshell.env("HOME")

    // --- Venster -----------------------------------------------------------

    function openWindow() {
        Wallpaper.lastError = ""
        win.statusMessage = ""
        win.confirmDeletePath = ""
        Wallpaper.refresh()
        win.ensureSelection()
        win.visible = true
        rootFocus.forceActiveFocus()
    }

    function closeWindow() {
        win.pickerOpen = false
        win.visible = false
    }

    function toggleWindow() {
        if (win.visible)
            win.closeWindow()
        else
            win.openWindow()
    }

    function open() {
        win.openWindow()
    }

    function close() {
        win.closeWindow()
    }

    function toggle() {
        win.toggleWindow()
    }

    function ensureSelection() {
        if (win.selectedPath.length > 0 && Wallpaper.hasPath(win.selectedPath))
            return
        if (Wallpaper.currentPath.length > 0
                && Wallpaper.hasPath(Wallpaper.currentPath)) {
            win.selectedPath = Wallpaper.currentPath
            return
        }
        win.selectedPath = Wallpaper.items.length > 0
            ? Wallpaper.items[0].path : ""
    }

    function selectedItem() {
        for (let i = 0; i < Wallpaper.items.length; i++) {
            if (Wallpaper.items[i].path === win.selectedPath)
                return Wallpaper.items[i]
        }
        return null
    }

    function showMessage(text) {
        win.statusMessage = text
        messageTimer.restart()
    }

    function applySelected() {
        if (win.selectedPath.length === 0 || Wallpaper.busy)
            return
        if (Wallpaper.apply(win.selectedPath))
            win.showMessage("Bezig met toepassen…")
    }

    function applyNext() {
        if (Wallpaper.busy)
            return
        if (Wallpaper.next())
            win.showMessage("Volgende wallpaper wordt toegepast…")
    }

    function requestDelete() {
        if (win.selectedPath.length === 0 || Wallpaper.busy)
            return
        if (win.confirmDeletePath === win.selectedPath) {
            win.confirmDeletePath = ""
            deleteTimer.stop()
            if (Wallpaper.remove(win.selectedPath))
                win.showMessage("Bezig met verwijderen…")
            return
        }
        win.confirmDeletePath = win.selectedPath
        deleteTimer.restart()
        win.showMessage("Nog één keer klikken om te verwijderen")
    }

    onClosed: win.visible = false

    onVisibleChanged: {
        if (win.visible) {
            Wallpaper.refresh()
            win.ensureSelection()
            rootFocus.forceActiveFocus()
        } else {
            win.pickerOpen = false
        }
    }

    Timer {
        id: messageTimer
        interval: 4500
        repeat: false
        onTriggered: win.statusMessage = ""
    }

    Timer {
        id: deleteTimer
        interval: 3500
        repeat: false
        onTriggered: win.confirmDeletePath = ""
    }

    Shortcut {
        sequence: "Escape"
        context: Qt.WindowShortcut
        onActivated: {
            if (win.pickerOpen)
                win.closePicker()
            else
                win.closeWindow()
        }
    }

    Connections {
        target: Wallpaper

        function onItemsChanged() {
            if (!win.visible)
                return
            win.ensureSelection()
        }

        function onAdded(path) {
            win.pickerOpen = false
            win.selectedPath = path
            win.showMessage("Toegevoegd: " + Wallpaper.fileName(path))
        }

        function onBusyChanged() {
            if (Wallpaper.busy)
                return
            if (win.statusMessage === "Bezig met toepassen…"
                    || win.statusMessage === "Bezig met verwijderen…"
                    || win.statusMessage === "Toevoegen…")
                win.statusMessage = ""
        }

        function onRemoved(path) {
            if (win.selectedPath === path)
                win.selectedPath = ""
            win.ensureSelection()
            win.showMessage("Verwijderd: " + Wallpaper.fileName(path))
        }
    }

    // --- Bestandsbrowser: mappen en afbeeldingen ---------------------------

    function normalizePath(path) {
        let value = String(path).trim()
        if (value.length === 0)
            return win.home
        if (value === "~")
            value = win.home
        else if (value.indexOf("~/") === 0)
            value = win.home + value.slice(1)
        while (value.length > 1 && value.charAt(value.length - 1) === "/")
            value = value.slice(0, value.length - 1)
        return value
    }

    function parentPath(path) {
        const value = win.normalizePath(path)
        if (value === "/")
            return "/"
        const index = value.lastIndexOf("/")
        return index <= 0 ? "/" : value.slice(0, index)
    }

    function joinPath(directory, name) {
        return directory === "/" ? "/" + name : directory + "/" + name
    }

    function openPicker() {
        win.pickerOpen = true
        win.pickerSelected = ""
        win.pickerError = ""
        win.loadFolder(win.home + "/Pictures")
        pickerPathInput.forceActiveFocus()
        pickerPathInput.selectAll()
    }

    function closePicker() {
        win.pickerOpen = false
        win.pickerSelected = ""
        rootFocus.forceActiveFocus()
    }

    function loadFolder(path) {
        if (folderProcess.running)
            return
        win.pickerPath = win.normalizePath(path)
        win.pickerDraftPath = win.pickerPath
        win.pickerSelected = ""
        win.pickerError = ""
        win.pickerEntries = []
        win.pickerScanning = true
        folderProcess.command = ["sh", "-c",
            'find "$1" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf "%y\\t%f\\n"; exit 0',
            "wallpaper-browse", win.pickerPath]
        folderProcess.running = true
    }

    function chooseEntry(entry) {
        if (entry.kind === "dir" || entry.kind === "parent") {
            win.loadFolder(entry.path)
            return
        }
        win.pickerSelected = entry.path
    }

    function addPicked() {
        if (win.pickerSelected.length === 0 || Wallpaper.busy)
            return
        const destination = Wallpaper.add(win.pickerSelected)
        if (destination.length > 0) {
            const alreadyThere = destination === win.pickerSelected
            win.pickerOpen = false
            win.selectedPath = destination
            win.showMessage(alreadyThere
                ? "Deze wallpaper staat al in de map"
                : "Toevoegen…")
        } else if (Wallpaper.lastError.length > 0) {
            win.pickerError = Wallpaper.lastError
        }
    }

    Process {
        id: folderProcess

        stdout: StdioCollector {
            waitForEnd: true

            onStreamFinished: {
                const lines = text.split("\n")
                const result = []

                if (win.pickerPath !== "/") {
                    result.push({
                        kind: "parent",
                        name: "..",
                        path: win.parentPath(win.pickerPath)
                    })
                }

                const dirs = []
                const files = []

                for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
                    const line = lines[i]
                    const tab = line.indexOf("\t")
                    if (tab < 1)
                        continue
                    const kind = line.slice(0, tab)
                    const name = line.slice(tab + 1)
                    if (name.length === 0 || name.charAt(0) === ".")
                        continue
                    const path = win.joinPath(win.pickerPath, name)

                    if (kind === "d") {
                        dirs.push({ kind: "dir", name: name, path: path })
                    } else if (kind === "f" && Wallpaper.isImage(name)) {
                        files.push({ kind: "image", name: name, path: path })
                    }
                }

                dirs.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name) })
                files.sort(function(a, b) { return a.name.localeCompare(b.name) })
                win.pickerEntries = result.concat(dirs, files)
            }
        }

        stderr: StdioCollector {
            waitForEnd: true
            onStreamFinished: win.pickerError = text.trim()
        }

        onExited: win.pickerScanning = false
    }

    // --- Hoofdindeling -----------------------------------------------------

    Rectangle {
        id: rootFocus

        anchors.fill: parent
        color: Theme.base
        border.width: 1
        border.color: Theme.surface0
        focus: true

        Keys.onEscapePressed: {
            if (win.pickerOpen)
                win.closePicker()
            else
                win.closeWindow()
        }

        // --- Titelbalk ----------------------------------------------------
        Rectangle {
            id: header

            anchors {
                left: parent.left
                right: parent.right
                top: parent.top
            }
            height: 56
            color: Theme.mantle

            Rectangle {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    bottom: parent.bottom
                }
                height: 1
                color: Theme.surface0
            }

            RowLayout {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    leftMargin: 18
                    rightMargin: 12
                }
                spacing: 10

                Text {
                    text: "\uf03e" // image
                    color: Theme.accent
                    font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontLarge
                }

                Text {
                    text: "Wallpapers"
                    color: Theme.text
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontLarge + 1
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                }

                Rectangle {
                    Layout.leftMargin: 4
                    Layout.preferredWidth: countLabel.implicitWidth + 16
                    Layout.preferredHeight: 20
                    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignVCenter
                    radius: 10
                    color: Theme.surface0

                    Text {
                        id: countLabel
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: Wallpaper.items.length + " afbeeldingen"
                        color: Theme.overlay1
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    Layout.leftMargin: 4
                    text: Wallpaper.wallpaperDir.replace(win.home, "~")
                    color: Theme.overlay0
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                    elide: Text.ElideMiddle
                }

                Item {
                    Layout.preferredWidth: 24
                    Layout.preferredHeight: 24

                    Rectangle {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                        color: closeArea.containsMouse ? Theme.surface0 : "transparent"
                    }

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "\uf00d" // xmark
                        color: Theme.overlay1
                        font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        id: closeArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: win.closeWindow()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Werkbalk -----------------------------------------------------
        Rectangle {
            id: toolbar

            anchors {
                left: parent.left
                right: parent.right
                top: header.bottom
            }
            height: 48
            color: Theme.base

            Rectangle {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    bottom: parent.bottom
                }
                height: 1
                color: Theme.surface0
            }

            RowLayout {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    leftMargin: 18
                    rightMargin: 18
                }
                spacing: 8

                ActionButton {
                    text: "Toevoegen"
                    icon: "\uf067" // plus
                    onClicked: win.openPicker()
                }

                ActionButton {
                    text: "Vernieuwen"
                    icon: "\uf021" // rotate
                    onClicked: {
                        Wallpaper.refresh()
                        win.showMessage("Wallpaperlijst vernieuwd")
                    }
                }

                Item {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                Text {
                    visible: Wallpaper.scanning
                    text: "Lijst laden…"
                    color: Theme.overlay0
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                }

                Text {
                    text: "Dubbelklik op een afbeelding om direct toe te passen"
                    color: Theme.overlay0
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Lijst en voorbeeld -------------------------------------------
        RowLayout {
            id: content

            anchors {
                left: parent.left
                right: parent.right
                top: toolbar.bottom
                bottom: footer.top
                margins: 18
            }
            spacing: 16

            Flickable {
                id: gridView

                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.fillHeight: true
                contentWidth: width
                contentHeight: gridFlow.height + 8
                clip: true
                boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

                WheelHandler {
                    onWheel: (event) => {
                        gridView.contentY = Math.max(0, Math.min(
                            gridView.contentHeight - gridView.height,
                            gridView.contentY - event.angleDelta.y * 0.6))
                    }
                }

                Flow {
                    id: gridFlow

                    width: gridView.width
                    spacing: 14

                    Repeater {
                        model: Wallpaper.items

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            id: card

                            required property var modelData

                            readonly property bool selected:
                                win.selectedPath === card.modelData.path
                            readonly property bool current:
                                Wallpaper.currentPath === card.modelData.path

                            width: 214
                            height: 178
                            radius: Theme.radiusSmall + 2
                            color: card.selected ? Theme.surface0 : Theme.mantle
                            border.width: card.selected ? 2 : 1
                            border.color: card.selected
                                ? Theme.accent
                                : (cardArea.containsMouse
                                    ? Theme.surface1 : Theme.surface0)

                            Rectangle {
                                anchors {
                                    left: parent.left
                                    right: parent.right
                                    top: parent.top
                                    margins: 8
                                }
                                height: 112
                                radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                                color: Theme.crust
                                clip: true

                                Image {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    source: Wallpaper.fileUrl(card.modelData.path)
                                    sourceSize.width: 430
                                    sourceSize.height: 230
                                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                    asynchronous: true
                                    cache: true
                                }

                                Rectangle {
                                    visible: card.current
                                    anchors {
                                        left: parent.left
                                        top: parent.top
                                        margins: 7
                                    }
                                    width: currentLabel.implicitWidth + 14
                                    height: 20
                                    radius: 10
                                    color: Theme.green

                                    Text {
                                        id: currentLabel
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        text: "Actief"
                                        color: Theme.crust
                                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontTiny
                                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            Text {
                                anchors {
                                    left: parent.left
                                    right: parent.right
                                    top: parent.top
                                    topMargin: 126
                                    leftMargin: 9
                                    rightMargin: 9
                                }
                                text: Wallpaper.displayName(card.modelData.path)
                                color: card.current ? Theme.green : Theme.text
                                font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                                font.weight: card.selected ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal
                                elide: Text.ElideMiddle
                            }

                            Text {
                                anchors {
                                    left: parent.left
                                    right: parent.right
                                    bottom: parent.bottom
                                    bottomMargin: 8
                                    leftMargin: 9
                                    rightMargin: 9
                                }
                                text: card.current
                                    ? "Huidige wallpaper"
                                    : (card.selected ? "Geselecteerd" : "Klik voor voorbeeld")
                                color: card.current
                                    ? Theme.green
                                    : (card.selected ? Theme.accent : Theme.overlay0)
                                font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontTiny
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                id: cardArea
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: win.selectedPath = card.modelData.path
                                onDoubleClicked: {
                                    win.selectedPath = card.modelData.path
                                    win.applySelected()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // Lege toestand.
                    Text {
                        visible: Wallpaper.items.length === 0 && !Wallpaper.scanning
                        width: gridView.width
                        text: "Nog geen wallpapers gevonden.\n"
                            + "Gebruik “Toevoegen” of zet een afbeelding in "
                            + Wallpaper.wallpaperDir.replace(win.home, "~") + "."
                        color: Theme.overlay0
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        topPadding: 40
                    }
                }
            }

            // Groot voorbeeld van de selectie.
            Rectangle {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 348
                Layout.fillHeight: true
                radius: Theme.radiusSmall + 2
                color: Theme.mantle
                border.width: 1
                border.color: Theme.surface0

                ColumnLayout {
                    anchors {
                        fill: parent
                        margins: 14
                    }
                    spacing: 10

                    Text {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: "VOORBEELD"
                        color: Theme.overlay1
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        font.letterSpacing: 0.8
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.fillHeight: true
                        radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                        color: Theme.crust
                        clip: true
                        border.width: 1
                        border.color: Theme.surface0

                        Image {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            source: win.selectedPath.length > 0
                                ? Wallpaper.fileUrl(win.selectedPath) : ""
                            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
                            asynchronous: true
                            cache: false
                        }

                        Text {
                            visible: win.selectedPath.length === 0
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "\uf03e"
                            color: Theme.overlay0
                            font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.scaled(48)
                        }
                    }

                    Text {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: {
                            const item = win.selectedItem()
                            return item ? Wallpaper.displayName(item.path)
                                : "Geen wallpaper geselecteerd"
                        }
                        color: Theme.text
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        elide: Text.ElideMiddle
                    }

                    Text {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        text: {
                            const item = win.selectedItem()
                            if (!item)
                                return ""
                            const prefix = item.isDefault
                                ? "Standaardwallpaper  ·  " : ""
                            return prefix + item.path.replace(win.home, "~")
                        }
                        color: Theme.overlay0
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontTiny
                        elide: Text.ElideMiddle
                    }

                    Text {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        visible: {
                            const item = win.selectedItem()
                            return item !== null && item.path === Wallpaper.currentPath
                        }
                        text: "Deze wallpaper is nu actief"
                        color: Theme.green
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                    }

                    RowLayout {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        spacing: 8

                        ActionButton {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            text: Wallpaper.busy ? "Bezig…" : "Toepassen"
                            icon: "\uf00c" // check
                            primary: true
                            enabled: win.selectedPath.length > 0 && !Wallpaper.busy
                            onClicked: win.applySelected()
                        }

                        ActionButton {
                            text: win.confirmDeletePath === win.selectedPath
                                && win.selectedPath.length > 0
                                ? "Zeker?" : "Verwijderen"
                            icon: "\uf1f8" // trash
                            danger: win.confirmDeletePath === win.selectedPath
                            compact: true
                            enabled: win.selectedPath.length > 0
                                && !Wallpaper.busy
                                && win.selectedPath.indexOf(Wallpaper.wallpaperDir + "/") === 0
                                && win.selectedPath !== Wallpaper.currentPath
                            onClicked: win.requestDelete()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Voettekst ----------------------------------------------------
        Rectangle {
            id: footer

            anchors {
                left: parent.left
                right: parent.right
                bottom: parent.bottom
            }
            height: 54
            color: Theme.mantle

            Rectangle {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    top: parent.top
                }
                height: 1
                color: Theme.surface0
            }

            RowLayout {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    leftMargin: 18
                    rightMargin: 18
                }
                spacing: 10

                Text {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: {
                        if (Wallpaper.lastError.length > 0)
                            return Wallpaper.lastError
                        if (win.statusMessage.length > 0)
                            return win.statusMessage
                        if (Wallpaper.lastAction.length > 0)
                            return Wallpaper.lastAction
                        return "Kies een wallpaper en klik op Toepassen"
                    }
                    color: Wallpaper.lastError.length > 0
                        ? Theme.red
                        : (win.statusMessage.length > 0
                            ? Theme.green : Theme.overlay1)
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                }

                ActionButton {
                    text: "Volgende"
                    icon: "\uf061" // arrow-right
                    enabled: !Wallpaper.busy
                    onClicked: win.applyNext()
                }

                ActionButton {
                    text: "Sluiten"
                    primary: true
                    onClicked: win.closeWindow()
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Toevoegen: ingebouwde bestandsbrowser ------------------------
        Rectangle {
            id: pickerOverlay

            anchors.fill: parent
            visible: win.pickerOpen
            color: "#aa000000"
            z: 100

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: win.closePicker()
            }

            Rectangle {
                id: pickerPanel

                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: Math.min(parent.width - 48, 820)
                height: Math.min(parent.height - 48, 590)
                radius: Theme.radiusSmall + 4
                color: Theme.base
                border.width: 1
                border.color: Theme.surface1

                // Klikken op lege plekken in het paneel mogen de overlay niet
                // sluiten; inhoud hierboven houdt zijn eigen klikgedrag.
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: pickerHeader

                    anchors {
                        left: parent.left
                        right: parent.right
                        top: parent.top
                    }
                    height: 50
                    color: Theme.mantle
                    radius: pickerPanel.radius

                    Rectangle {
                        anchors {
                            left: parent.left
                            right: parent.right
                            bottom: parent.bottom
                        }
                        height: 1
                        color: Theme.surface0
                    }

                    RowLayout {
                        anchors {
                            left: parent.left
                            right: parent.right
                            verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            leftMargin: 16
                            rightMargin: 12
                        }
                        spacing: 9

                        Text {
                            text: "\uf067" // plus
                            color: Theme.accent
                            font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                        }

                        Text {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            text: "Wallpaper toevoegen"
                            color: Theme.text
                            font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                            font.pixelSize: Theme.fontLarge
                            font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                        }

                        Item {
                            Layout.preferredWidth: 24
                            Layout.preferredHeight: 24

                            Rectangle {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                                color: pickerCloseArea.containsMouse
                                    ? Theme.surface0 : "transparent"
                            }

                            Text {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: "\uf00d"
                                color: Theme.overlay1
                                font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                            }

                            MouseArea {
                                id: pickerCloseArea
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: win.closePicker()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                RowLayout {
                    anchors {
                        left: parent.left
                        right: parent.right
                        top: pickerHeader.bottom
                        bottom: pickerFooter.top

// SnapperCreateWindow.qml — dialoog voor een nieuwe snapper-momentopname.
//
// Een PopupWindow krijgt onder X11 geen toetsenbordfocus (issue #794); daarom
// is dit een klein FloatingWindow, net als de instellingen- en
// wallpapervensters. De beschrijving is optioneel. Aanmaken loopt via de
// Snapper-service, die bij ontbrekende leesrechten automatisch via pkexec om
// bevoegdheid vraagt.

import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell
import "../theme"
import "../services"

FloatingWindow {
    id: win

    title: "Nieuwe momentopname"
    implicitWidth: Theme.scaled(520)
    implicitHeight: Theme.scaled(300)
    minimumSize: Qt.size(Theme.scaled(440), Theme.scaled(260))
    color: Theme.base
    visible: false

    property string description: ""
    property string localError: ""

    function openWindow() {
        win.description = ""
        win.localError = ""
        win.visible = true
        rootFocus.forceActiveFocus()
        descriptionInput.forceActiveFocus()
    }

    function closeWindow() {
        if (Snapper.busy)
            return
        win.visible = false
    }

    function toggleWindow() {
        if (win.visible)
            win.closeWindow()
        else
            win.openWindow()
    }

    function submit() {
        if (Snapper.busy)
            return

        win.localError = ""
        if (!Snapper.create(win.description)) {
            win.localError = Snapper.lastError.length > 0
                ? Snapper.lastError
                : "Kon geen momentopname aanmaken"
        }
    }

    onClosed: win.visible = false

    onVisibleChanged: {
        if (win.visible) {
            win.localError = ""
            rootFocus.forceActiveFocus()
            descriptionInput.forceActiveFocus()
        }
    }

    Connections {
        target: Snapper

        function onCreated(number) {
            win.visible = false
        }

        function onActionFinished(ok, message) {
            if (!ok && win.visible)
                win.localError = message
        }
    }

    Shortcut {
        sequence: "Escape"
        context: Qt.WindowShortcut
        onActivated: win.closeWindow()
    }

    Item {
        id: rootFocus

        anchors.fill: parent
        focus: true

        Keys.onEscapePressed: win.closeWindow()

        Rectangle {
            anchors.fill: parent
            color: Theme.base
            border.width: 1
            border.color: Theme.surface0
        }

        Rectangle {
            id: header

            anchors {
                left: parent.left
                right: parent.right
                top: parent.top
            }
            height: Theme.scaled(50)
            color: Theme.mantle

            Rectangle {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    bottom: parent.bottom
                }
                height: 1
                color: Theme.surface0
            }

            RowLayout {
                anchors {
                    left: parent.left
                    right: parent.right
                    verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    leftMargin: Theme.scaled(18)
                    rightMargin: Theme.scaled(12)
                }
                spacing: Theme.scaled(10)

                Text {
                    text: "\uf1da" // clock-rotate-left
                    color: Theme.accent
                    font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontLarge
                }

                Text {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: "Nieuwe momentopname"
                    color: Theme.text
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontLarge
                    font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                }

                Item {
                    Layout.preferredWidth: Theme.scaled(24)
                    Layout.preferredHeight: Theme.scaled(24)

                    Rectangle {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                        color: closeArea.containsMouse ? Theme.surface0 : "transparent"
                    }

                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "\uf00d" // xmark
                        color: Theme.overlay1
                        font.family: Theme.iconFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        id: closeArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: win.closeWindow()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors {
                fill: parent
                topMargin: header.height + Theme.scaled(18)
                leftMargin: Theme.scaled(18)
                rightMargin: Theme.scaled(18)
                bottomMargin: Theme.scaled(16)
            }
            spacing: Theme.scaled(10)

            Text {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: "Configuratie: " + (Snapper.activeConfig.length > 0
                    ? Snapper.activeConfig : "—")
                    + (Snapper.activeSubvolume.length > 0
                        ? "  ·  " + Snapper.activeSubvolume : "")
                color: Theme.barMuted

            Text {

                radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                color: Theme.mantle
                border.width: 1
                border.color: descriptionInput.activeFocus

                }

                Text {

                    visible: descriptionInput.text.length === 0
                    text: "Bijvoorbeeld: voor update"
                    color: Theme.overlay1
                    font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                    font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                }
            }

            TextEdit {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: Snapper.accessError.length > 0
                text: "Je gebruiker heeft nog geen snapper-rechten. "
                    + "Voer eenmalig uit:\n" + Snapper.setupCommand

                readOnly: true
                selectByMouse: true
                textFormat: TextEdit.PlainText
                color: Theme.yellow
                font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                wrapMode: TextEdit.WordWrap
            }

            Text {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: win.localError.length > 0
                text: win.localError
                color: Theme.red
                font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
                wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
            }

            Text {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                visible: Snapper.busy
                text: "Bezig met aanmaken…"
                color: Theme.yellow
                font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                font.pixelSize: Theme.fontSmall
            }

            Item {
                Layout.fillHeight: true
            }

            RowLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: Theme.scaled(8)

                Item {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                }

                Rectangle {
                    Layout.preferredWidth: cancelLabel.implicitWidth + Theme.scaled(24)
                    Layout.preferredHeight: Theme.scaled(32)
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    color: cancelArea.containsMouse

                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Annuleren"
                        color: Theme.text
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        id: cancelArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: win.closeWindow()
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    Layout.preferredWidth: createLabel.implicitWidth + Theme.scaled(24)
                    Layout.preferredHeight: Theme.scaled(32)
                    radius: Theme.radiusSmall
                    color: Snapper.busy ? Theme.surface0
                        : (createArea.containsMouse ? Theme.accent : Theme.blue)
                    opacity: Snapper.available && !Snapper.busy ? 1 : 0.55

                    Text {
                        id: createLabel
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: Snapper.busy ? "Bezig…" : "Aanmaken"
                        color: Theme.crust
                        font.family: Theme.fontFamily
                        font.pixelSize: Theme.fontNormal
                        font.weight: Font.DemiBold
                    }

                    MouseArea {
                        id: createArea
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        hoverEnabled: true
                        enabled: Snapper.available && !Snapper.busy
                        cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                        onClicked: win.submit()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Pure parser voor de bspc subscribe report-regel: monitors, desktops, layout en node-status.

  • Ondersteunt het report-formaat W[M|m]<monitor> : O/o/F/f/U/u<desktop> … : L(T|M) : T(…) : G(…).
  • Alleen de gefocuste monitor bepaalt layout en node-status in het eindresultaat.
  • Lege desktops of receptacles zonder client leveren geen T/G; T@ betekent receptacle.
  • Geen QML-afhankelijkheden, zodat de parser los testbaar is.

// ReportParser.js — parser voor de `bspc subscribe report`-regel.
//
// Formaat (zie bspwm(1), REPORT FORMAT):
//
//   W[M|m]<monitor> : O/o/F/f/U/u<desktop> ... : L(T|M) [: T(...) : G(...)] ...
//
// Let op:
// - De regel begint met de configureerbare status_prefix (standaard "W"),
//   direct gevolgd door de eerste monitor (M of m).
// - L, T en G horen bij de monitor die ervoor genoemd is. Alleen de monitor
//   met een hoofdletter (M) is gefocust; alleen daarvan nemen we layout en
//   node-status over in het eindresultaat.
// - Heeft de gefocuste desktop geen gefocuste node (lege desktop of alleen
//   receptacles zonder client), dan ontbreken T en G volledig.
// - T@ betekent: de gefocuste node is een receptacle zonder client.

function emptyFlags() {
    return {
        sticky: false,
        private: false,
        locked: false,
        marked: false
    }
}

function emptyMonitor(name, focused) {
    return {
        name: name,
        focused: focused,
        layout: "tiled",
        activeNodeState: "",
        activeNodeFlags: emptyFlags(),
        desktops: []
    }
}

function initialState() {
    return {
        monitors: [],
        desktops: [],
        focusedMonitor: "",
        focusedDesktop: "",
        layout: "tiled",
        activeNodeState: "",
        activeNodeFlags: emptyFlags()
    }
}

function stateName(character) {
    switch (character) {
    case "T": return "tiled"
    case "P": return "pseudo_tiled"
    case "F": return "floating"
    case "=": return "fullscreen"
    case "@": return "receptacle"
    default: return ""
    }
}

function flagsFromString(flags) {
    return {
        sticky: flags.indexOf("S") >= 0,
        private: flags.indexOf("P") >= 0,
        locked: flags.indexOf("L") >= 0,
        marked: flags.indexOf("M") >= 0
    }
}

function parseReport(report) {
    var result = initialState()
    if (!report)
        return result

    var text = String(report).trim()
    if (text.length === 0)
        return result

    var items = text.split(":")
    var currentMonitor = null

    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
        var item = items[i]
        if (item.length === 0)
            continue

        var type = item.charAt(0)

        // De allereerste regel begint met status_prefix ("W").
        if (i === 0 && type === "W") {
            item = item.substring(1)
            if (item.length === 0)
                continue
            type = item.charAt(0)
        }

        switch (type) {
        case "M":
        case "m": {
            currentMonitor = emptyMonitor(item.substring(1), type === "M")
            result.monitors.push(currentMonitor)
            if (currentMonitor.focused)
                result.focusedMonitor = currentMonitor.name
            break
        }

        case "O":
        case "o":
        case "F":
        case "f":
        case "U":
        case "u": {
            if (currentMonitor === null) {
                currentMonitor = emptyMonitor("", true)
                result.monitors.push(currentMonitor)
            }

            var focused = (type === "O" || type === "F" || type === "U")
            var desktop = {
                name: item.substring(1),
                monitor: currentMonitor.name,
                focused: focused,
                occupied: (type === "O" || type === "o" || type === "U" || type === "u"),
                urgent: (type === "U" || type === "u")
            }
            currentMonitor.desktops.push(desktop)
            result.desktops.push(desktop)

            if (focused && currentMonitor.focused)
                result.focusedDesktop = desktop.name
            break
        }

        case "L": {
            var layout = item.substring(1) === "M" ? "monocle" : "tiled"
            if (currentMonitor === null) {
                currentMonitor = emptyMonitor("", true)
                result.monitors.push(currentMonitor)
            }
            currentMonitor.layout = layout
            if (currentMonitor.focused)
                result.layout = layout
            break
        }

        case "T": {
            var state = stateName(item.substring(1))
            if (currentMonitor !== null)
                currentMonitor.activeNodeState = state
            if (currentMonitor === null || currentMonitor.focused)
                result.activeNodeState = state
            break
        }

        case "G": {
            var flags = flagsFromString(item.substring(1))
            if (currentMonitor !== null)
                currentMonitor.activeNodeFlags = flags
            if (currentMonitor === null || currentMonitor.focused)
                result.activeNodeFlags = flags
            break
        }
        }
    }

    return result
}

.pragma library

// SxhkdParser.js — leest een sxhkdrc en maakt er een doorzoekbare lijst van.
//
// Conventies in de sxhkdrc (zie ook de kop van config/sxhkd/sxhkdrc):
//   - een comment direct boven een hotkey is de omschrijving;
//   - "# --- Sectie ---" begint een groep;
//   - ingesprongen regels onder een hotkey zijn het commando;
//   - een regel die op \ eindigt loopt door op de volgende regel.
//
// Daarnaast worden de sxhkd-syntaxregels ondersteund die in dit project
// voorkomen: chord-chains met ; of :, brace-expansie {a,b} (in hotkey én
// commando, parallel uitgevoerd als de groepen even groot zijn), en
// bereik-expansie {1-9}/{a-z}. De underscore staat voor een lege optie.
//
// De parser is bewust een pure functie zonder QML-afhankelijkheden, zodat
// ShortcutsWindow.qml hem ook via IPC kan laten testen.

function isBlank(line) {
    return line === null || line === undefined || String(line).trim().length === 0
}

function isComment(line) {
    return String(line).replace(/^\s+/, "").charAt(0) === "#"
}

function isIndented(line) {
    return /^\s/.test(String(line)) && !isBlank(line)
}

// Commenttekst zonder # en omringende spaties.
function commentText(line) {
    return String(line).replace(/^\s*#\s?/, "").trim()
}

// "# --- Sectie ---" (minimaal twee streepjes aan beide kanten).
function sectionTitle(line) {
    const match = String(line).match(/^\s*#\s*-{2,}\s*(.+?)\s*-{2,}\s*$/)
    return match ? match[1].trim() : ""
}

// Splitst tekst op scheidingstekens die niet binnen brace-groepen staan.
function splitTopLevel(text, separators) {
    const parts = []
    var current = ""
    var depth = 0
    var escaped = false

    for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const character = text.charAt(i)

        if (escaped) {
            current += character
            escaped = false
            continue
        }
        if (character === "\\") {
            current += character
            escaped = true
            continue
        }
        if (character === "{") {
            depth++
            current += character
            continue
        }
        if (character === "}") {
            if (depth > 0)
                depth--
            current += character
            continue
        }
        if (depth === 0 && separators.indexOf(character) >= 0) {
            parts.push(current)
            current = ""
            continue
        }
        current += character
    }

    parts.push(current)
    return parts
}

// Vindt de buitenste brace-groepen en hun positie in de tekst.
function findGroups(text) {
    const groups = []
    var depth = 0
    var start = -1

    for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        const character = text.charAt(i)
        if (character === "{" && depth === 0) {
            start = i
            depth = 1
        } else if (character === "{" && depth > 0) {
            depth++
        } else if (character === "}" && depth > 0) {
            depth--
            if (depth === 0) {
                groups.push({
                    start: start,
                    end: i,
                    body: text.substring(start + 1, i)
                })
                start = -1
            }
        }
    }

    return groups
}

function expandRange(option) {
    const numeric = option.match(/^([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$/)
    if (numeric) {
        const first = parseInt(numeric[1], 10)
        const last = parseInt(numeric[2], 10)
        if (first > last || last - first > 512)
            return null
        const values = []
        for (var n = first; n <= last; n++)
            values.push(String(n))
        return values
    }

    const alpha = option.match(/^([A-Za-z])-([A-Za-z])$/)
    if (alpha) {
        const firstCode = alpha[1].charCodeAt(0)
        const lastCode = alpha[2].charCodeAt(0)
        if (firstCode > lastCode || lastCode - firstCode > 128)
            return null
        const values = []
        for (var c = firstCode; c <= lastCode; c++)
            values.push(String.fromCharCode(c))
        return values
    }

    return null
}

function optionList(body) {
    const raw = splitTopLevel(body, [","])
    const options = []

    for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        const option = raw[i].trim()
        if (option === "_") {
            options.push("")
            continue
        }
        const range = expandRange(option)
        if (range !== null) {
            for (var j = 0; j < range.length; j++)
                options.push(range[j])
        } else {
            options.push(option)
        }
    }

    if (options.length === 0)
        options.push("")
    return options
}

// Alle indexcombinaties voor de brace-groepen, in leesorde.
function cartesian(groups) {
    var tuples = [[]]
    for (var i = 0; i < groups.length; i++) {
        const next = []
        const options = groups[i].options
        for (var t = 0; t < tuples.length; t++) {
            for (var o = 0; o < options.length; o++)
                next.push(tuples[t].concat([o]))
        }
        tuples = next
    }
    return tuples
}

function applyTuple(text, groups, tuple) {
    var result = text
    for (var i = groups.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const group = groups[i]
        const options = group.options
        const index = tuple.length > i
            ? Math.min(tuple[i], options.length - 1) : 0
        result = result.substring(0, group.start)
            + options[index]
            + result.substring(group.end + 1)
    }
    return result
}

function tokenLabel(token) {
    const lower = token.toLowerCase()
    const names = {
        "super": "Super",
        "mod4": "Super",
        "hyper": "Hyper",
        "meta": "Meta",
        "alt": "Alt",
        "mod1": "Alt",
        "ctrl": "Ctrl",
        "control": "Ctrl",
        "shift": "Shift",
        "mode_switch": "Mode_switch",
        "lock": "Lock",
        "mod2": "Mod2",
        "mod3": "Mod3",
        "mod5": "Mod5",
        "return": "Return",
        "enter": "Return",
        "tab": "Tab",
        "escape": "Escape",
        "esc": "Escape",
        "space": "Space",
        "backspace": "Backspace",
        "delete": "Delete",
        "insert": "Insert",
        "home": "Home",
        "end": "End",
        "page_up": "PageUp",
        "page_down": "PageDown",
        "up": "↑",
        "down": "↓",
        "left": "←",
        "right": "→",
        "print": "Print",
        "menu": "Menu",
        "comma": ",",
        "period": ".",
        "slash": "/",
        "backslash": "\\",
        "minus": "-",
        "equal": "=",
        "grave": "`",
        "bracketleft": "[",
        "bracketright": "]",
        "semicolon": ";",
        "apostrophe": "'"
    }

    if (names[lower])
        return names[lower]

    // @ (release) en ~ (replay) horen bij het gedrag, niet bij de toetsnaam.
    var prefix = ""
    var name = token
    while (name.length > 0 && (name.charAt(0) === "@" || name.charAt(0) === "~")) {
        if (name.charAt(0) === "@")
            prefix += "@"
        else
            prefix += "~"
        name = name.substring(1)
    }

    var label = name
    if (name.length === 1)
        label = name.toUpperCase()
    else if (name.toLowerCase().indexOf("xf86") === 0)
        label = name.toUpperCase().replace("XF86", "XF86")
    else if (name.length > 0)
        label = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + name.substring(1)

    return prefix + label
}

// Zet een uitgeklapte hotkey om in losse chords met toetslabels.
// "super + h ; shift + l" -> [["Super", "H"], ["Shift", "L"]]
function parseChords(expandedKey) {
    const chordTexts = splitTopLevel(expandedKey, [";", ":"])
    const chords = []

    for (var i = 0; i < chordTexts.length; i++) {
        const chordText = chordTexts[i].trim()
        if (chordText.length === 0)
            continue

        const rawTokens = splitTopLevel(chordText, ["+"])
        const tokens = []
        for (var j = 0; j < rawTokens.length; j++) {
            const token = rawTokens[j].trim()
            if (token.length > 0)
                tokens.push(tokenLabel(token))
        }
        if (tokens.length > 0)
            chords.push(tokens)
    }

    return chords
}

function displayKey(chords) {
    const parts = []
    for (var i = 0; i < chords.length; i++)
        parts.push(chords[i].join("+"))
    return parts.join(" ; ")
}

// --- Eigen sneltoetsen -------------------------------------------------
//
// ShortcutsWindow schrijft eigen bindingen in hetzelfde sxhkdrc-bestand,
// tussen twee marker-comments:
//
//   # @qs-shortcut {"id":"qs-…","group":"Eigen sneltoetsen"}
//   # Omschrijving
//   super + shift + e
//       alacritty -e htop
//   # @qs-shortcut-end qs-…
//
// De markers zijn comments voor sxhkd en worden door de parser uit de
// omschrijving gefilterd. Zo blijft de sxhkdrc de enige bron en kan de UI
// precies haar eigen blokken terugvinden zonder handmatige regels te raken.

var MODIFIER_ORDER = {
    "super": 0,
    "ctrl": 1,
    "alt": 2,
    "shift": 3
}

var CUSTOM_GROUP = "Eigen sneltoetsen"

function canonicalKeyName(token) {
    const lower = token.toLowerCase()
    const names = {
        "super": "super",
        "mod4": "super",
        "ctrl": "ctrl",
        "control": "ctrl",
        "alt": "alt",
        "mod1": "alt",
        "shift": "shift",
        "return": "Return",
        "enter": "Return",
        "tab": "Tab",
        "escape": "Escape",
        "esc": "Escape",
        "space": "space",
        "backspace": "Backspace",
        "delete": "Delete",
        "insert": "Insert",
        "home": "Home",
        "end": "End",
        "page_up": "Page_Up",
        "pageup": "Page_Up",
        "page_down": "Page_Down",
        "pagedown": "Page_Down",
        "up": "Up",
        "down": "Down",
        "left": "Left",
        "right": "Right",
        "print": "Print",
        "menu": "Menu",
        "minus": "minus",
        "equal": "equal",
        "comma": "comma",
        "period": "period",
        "slash": "slash",
        "backslash": "backslash",
        "grave": "grave",
        "bracketleft": "bracketleft",
        "bracketright": "bracketright",
        "semicolon": "semicolon",
        "apostrophe": "apostrophe",
        "plus": "plus",
        "underscore": "underscore"
    }

    if (names[lower])
        return names[lower]

    // Veelgebruikte leestekens mogen gewoon als teken worden getypt.
    const punctuation = {
        "/": "slash",
        "-": "minus",
        "=": "equal",
        ",": "comma",
        ".": "period",
        "\\": "backslash",
        "[": "bracketleft",
        "]": "bracketright",
        "'": "apostrophe",
        "`": "grave",
        "_": "underscore"
    }
    if (punctuation[token])
        return punctuation[token]

    if (/^f([1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(lower))
        return lower.toUpperCase()
    if (/^xf86/.test(lower))
        return "XF86" + token.substring(4)
    if (token.length === 1)
        return lower
    return token
}

// Maakt van vrije invoer ("Super + Shift + X") de sxhkd-notatie
// ("super + shift + x"). Onbekende namen blijven staan, zodat brace-
// expansies en XF86-toetsen bruikbaar blijven.
function normalizeKeys(raw) {
    const text = String(raw === null || raw === undefined ? "" : raw).trim()
    if (text.length === 0)
        return ""

    const chordTexts = splitTopLevel(text, [";", ":"])
    const chords = []

    for (var c = 0; c < chordTexts.length; c++) {
        const chordText = chordTexts[c].trim()
        if (chordText.length === 0)
            continue

        const rawTokens = splitTopLevel(chordText, ["+"])
        const modifiers = []
        const keys = []

        for (var t = 0; t < rawTokens.length; t++) {
            const token = rawTokens[t].trim()
            if (token.length === 0)
                continue
            const name = canonicalKeyName(token)
            const lower = name.toLowerCase()
            if (token.charAt(0) !== "{" && MODIFIER_ORDER[lower] !== undefined)
                modifiers.push(name)
            else
                keys.push(name)
        }

        if (modifiers.length === 0 && keys.length === 0)
            continue

        modifiers.sort(function (a, b) {
            return MODIFIER_ORDER[a.toLowerCase()] - MODIFIER_ORDER[b.toLowerCase()]
        })
        chords.push(modifiers.concat(keys).join(" + "))
    }

    return chords.join(" ; ")
}

function validateKeys(raw) {
    const keys = normalizeKeys(raw)
    if (keys.length === 0)
        return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Vul een toetscombinatie in" }

    const chordTexts = splitTopLevel(keys, [";", ":"])
    var chordCount = 0

    for (var c = 0; c < chordTexts.length; c++) {
        const chordText = chordTexts[c].trim()
        if (chordText.length === 0)
            continue

        const tokens = splitTopLevel(chordText, ["+"])
        var keyCount = 0

        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t++) {
            const token = tokens[t].trim()
            if (token.length === 0)
                return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Er staat een lege toets in de combinatie" }

            const bare = token.replace(/^[~@]+/, "")
            if (bare.length === 0)
                return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Ongeldige toets “" + token + "”" }

            if (bare.charAt(0) === "{") {
                if (bare.charAt(bare.length - 1) !== "}")
                    return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Een brace-groep is niet gesloten" }
                keyCount++
                continue
            }

            if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/.test(bare))
                return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Ongeldige toets “" + token + "”" }

            if (MODIFIER_ORDER[bare.toLowerCase()] === undefined)
                keyCount++
        }

        if (keyCount === 0)
            return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Een combinatie heeft minstens één gewone toets nodig" }
        chordCount++
    }

    if (chordCount === 0)
        return { ok: false, keys: "", error: "Vul een toetscombinatie in" }

    return { ok: true, keys: keys, error: "" }
}

// Vergelijkt toetsen onafhankelijk van spaties en hoofdletters.
function keySignature(keys) {
    return String(keys === null || keys === undefined ? "" : keys)
        .toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, "")
}

// Alle concrete combinaties die een hotkey met brace-expansie oplevert,
// als genormaliseerde signaturen. Nodig om dubbele bindingen te detecteren
// voordat sxhkd ze allebei grabbt.
function keySignatures(raw) {
    const keys = normalizeKeys(raw)
    if (keys.length === 0)
        return []

    const groupsRaw = findGroups(keys)
    const groups = []
    for (var i = 0; i < groupsRaw.length; i++) {
        groups.push({
            start: groupsRaw[i].start,
            end: groupsRaw[i].end,
            options: optionList(groupsRaw[i].body)
        })
    }

    const tuples = cartesian(groups)
    const result = []
    for (var t = 0; t < tuples.length; t++) {
        const expanded = applyTuple(keys, groups, tuples[t])
        const signature = keySignature(expanded)
        if (result.indexOf(signature) < 0)
            result.push(signature)
    }
    return result
}

function canonicalModifier(token) {
    const lower = String(token).trim().toLowerCase()
    if (lower === "mod4")
        return "super"
    if (lower === "control")
        return "ctrl"
    if (lower === "mod1")
        return "alt"
    return lower
}

// Schakelt één modifier in de eerste chord en past die keuze op alle chords
// toe. Brace-groepen blijven intact omdat er brace-bewust gesplitst wordt.
function toggleModifier(raw, name) {
    const order = ["super", "ctrl", "alt", "shift"]
    const text = String(raw === null || raw === undefined ? "" : raw).trim()
    if (text.length === 0)
        return name

    const chordTexts = splitTopLevel(text, [";", ":"])
    const firstTokens = splitTopLevel(chordTexts[0], ["+"])
    var add = true
    for (var f = 0; f < firstTokens.length; f++) {
        if (canonicalModifier(firstTokens[f]) === name) {
            add = false
            break
        }
    }

    const chords = []
    for (var c = 0; c < chordTexts.length; c++) {
        const chordText = chordTexts[c].trim()
        if (chordText.length === 0)
            continue

        const tokens = splitTopLevel(chordText, ["+"])
        const modifiers = []
        const keys = []

        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t++) {
            const token = tokens[t].trim()
            if (token.length === 0)
                continue
            const canonical = canonicalModifier(token)
            if (token.charAt(0) !== "{" && order.indexOf(canonical) >= 0) {
                if (!(add === false && canonical === name))
                    modifiers.push(canonical === name ? name : canonical)
            } else {
                keys.push(token)
            }
        }

        if (add && modifiers.indexOf(name) < 0)
            modifiers.push(name)

        modifiers.sort(function (a, b) {
            return order.indexOf(a) - order.indexOf(b)
        })
        chords.push(modifiers.concat(keys).join(" + "))
    }

    return chords.join(" ; ")
}

function generateId() {
    return "qs-" + Date.now().toString(36) + "-"
        + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1679616).toString(36)
}

function parseCustomMeta(line) {
    const match = String(line).match(/^\s*#\s*@qs-shortcut\s+(\{.*\})\s*$/)
    if (!match)
        return null
    try {
        const data = JSON.parse(match[1])
        if (data && typeof data.id === "string" && data.id.length > 0)
            return data
    } catch (error) {
        return null
    }
    return null
}

function isCustomEnd(line) {
    return /^\s*#\s*@qs-shortcut-end\b/.test(String(line))
}

function findCustomBlock(lines, id) {
    var start = -1
    for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const meta = parseCustomMeta(lines[i])
        if (meta && meta.id === id) {
            start = i
            break
        }
    }
    if (start < 0)
        return null

    for (var end = start + 1; end < lines.length; end++) {
        if (isCustomEnd(lines[end]) && String(lines[end]).indexOf(id) >= 0)
            return { start: start, end: end }
    }
    return null
}

function cleanLines(text) {
    const lines = String(text === null || text === undefined ? "" : text)
        .split(/\r?\n/)
    while (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1].trim().length === 0)
        lines.pop()
    return lines
}

function customBlockLines(id, group, description, keys, command) {
    const lines = []
    lines.push("# @qs-shortcut " + JSON.stringify({ id: id, group: group }))
    if (description.length > 0)
        lines.push("# " + description.replace(/\r?\n/g, " ").trim())
    lines.push(keys)

    const commandLines = command.split(/\r?\n/)
    for (var i = 0; i < commandLines.length; i++)
        lines.push("\t" + commandLines[i].trim())

    lines.push("# @qs-shortcut-end " + id)
    return lines
}

// Voegt een eigen binding toe of vervangt hem op id. Het blok wordt achteraan
// het bestand gezet; handmatige regels en secties blijven onaangeroerd.
function upsertCustomShortcut(text, entry) {
    const checked = validateKeys(entry.keys)
    if (!checked.ok)
        return { ok: false, error: checked.error, id: "", text: String(text || "") }

    const command = String(entry.command === null || entry.command === undefined
        ? "" : entry.command).trim()
    if (command.length === 0)
        return { ok: false, error: "Vul een commando in", id: "", text: String(text || "") }

    const description = String(entry.description === null || entry.description === undefined
        ? "" : entry.description).trim()
    const group = String(entry.group === null || entry.group === undefined
        ? "" : entry.group).replace(/\r?\n/g, " ").trim() || CUSTOM_GROUP
    const id = String(entry.id === null || entry.id === undefined
        ? "" : entry.id).trim() || generateId()

    const lines = String(text === null || text === undefined ? "" : text).split(/\r?\n/)
    const block = findCustomBlock(lines, id)
    if (block)
        lines.splice(block.start, block.end - block.start + 1)

    while (lines.length > 0 && lines[lines.length - 1].trim().length === 0)
        lines.pop()
    if (lines.length > 0)
        lines.push("")

    const blockLines = customBlockLines(id, group, description,
        checked.keys, command)
    for (var i = 0; i < blockLines.length; i++)
        lines.push(blockLines[i])

    return { ok: true, error: "", id: id, text: lines.join("\n") + "\n" }
}

function removeCustomShortcut(text, id) {
    const source = String(text === null || text === undefined ? "" : text)
    const lines = source.split(/\r?\n/)
    const block = findCustomBlock(lines, String(id))
    if (!block)
        return { ok: false, error: "Sneltoets niet gevonden", id: String(id), text: source }

    lines.splice(block.start, block.end - block.start + 1)

    // Hooguit één lege regel overlaten waar het blok stond.
    while (block.start > 0 && block.start < lines.length
            && lines[block.start].trim().length === 0
            && lines[block.start - 1].trim().length === 0)
        lines.splice(block.start, 1)

    const result = cleanLines(lines.join("\n"))
    return {
        ok: true,
        error: "",
        id: String(id),
        text: result.length > 0 ? result.join("\n") + "\n" : ""
    }
}

// Leest één of meer ingesprongen commandoregels, inclusief \-continuties.
function readCommands(lines, startIndex) {
    const commands = []
    var current = ""
    var index = startIndex

    while (index < lines.length) {
        const line = lines[index]
        if (isBlank(line) || !isIndented(line))
            break

        var text = String(line).trim()
        if (text.length > 0 && text.charAt(text.length - 1) === "\\") {
            current += text.substring(0, text.length - 1).trim() + " "
            index++
            continue
        }

        current += text
        if (current.length > 0)
            commands.push(current)
        current = ""
        index++
    }

    if (current.length > 0)
        commands.push(current)

    return { commands: commands, next: index }
}

function expandEntry(keyText, commandText, section, description, lineNumber, meta) {
    const keyGroupsRaw = findGroups(keyText)
    const keyGroups = []
    for (var i = 0; i < keyGroupsRaw.length; i++) {
        keyGroups.push({
            start: keyGroupsRaw[i].start,
            end: keyGroupsRaw[i].end,
            options: optionList(keyGroupsRaw[i].body)
        })
    }

    const commandGroupsRaw = findGroups(commandText)
    const commandGroups = []
    for (var j = 0; j < commandGroupsRaw.length; j++) {
        commandGroups.push({
            start: commandGroupsRaw[j].start,
            end: commandGroupsRaw[j].end,
            options: optionList(commandGroupsRaw[j].body)
        })
    }

    const tuples = cartesian(keyGroups)
    const entries = []

    for (var t = 0; t < tuples.length; t++) {
        const tuple = tuples[t]
        const expandedKey = applyTuple(keyText, keyGroups, tuple)
        // Bij even grote groepen lopen hotkey en commando parallel (h -> west).
        // Wijkt de commando-expansie af, dan gebruikt applyTuple dezelfde
        // index waar mogelijk; dat is voor afwijkende configs de beste gok.
        const expandedCommand = commandGroups.length > 0
            ? applyTuple(commandText, commandGroups, tuple)
            : commandText
        const chords = parseChords(expandedKey)

        if (chords.length === 0)
            continue

        const key = displayKey(chords)
        const custom = !!(meta && typeof meta.id === "string"
            && meta.id.length > 0)
        const group = custom && typeof meta.group === "string"
            && meta.group.length > 0 ? meta.group : section
        entries.push({
            group: group,
            description: description,
            key: key,
            chords: chords,
            command: expandedCommand,
            line: lineNumber,
            custom: custom,
            id: custom ? meta.id : "",
            sourceKey: keyText,
            sourceCommand: commandText,
            search: (group + " " + description + " " + key + " "
                + expandedCommand).toLowerCase()
        })
    }

    return entries
}

// Hoofdfunctie: tekst -> { entries, groups, sections, error }.
function parseResult(text) {
    const lines = String(text === null || text === undefined ? "" : text)
        .split(/\r?\n/)
    const entries = []
    const groups = []
    var section = "Algemeen"
    var comments = []
    var pendingMeta = null

    var i = 0
    while (i < lines.length) {
        const line = lines[i]

        if (isBlank(line)) {
            comments = []
            i++
            continue
        }

        if (isComment(line)) {
            const meta = parseCustomMeta(line)
            if (meta !== null) {
                // Marker van een eigen binding: wel onthouden, niet tonen.
                pendingMeta = meta
                i++
                continue
            }
            if (isCustomEnd(line)) {
                pendingMeta = null
                i++
                continue
            }

            const title = sectionTitle(line)
            if (title.length > 0) {
                section = title
                comments = []
                pendingMeta = null
            } else {
                comments.push(commentText(line))
            }
            i++
            continue
        }

        if (isIndented(line)) {
            // Commando zonder voorafgaande hotkey: negeren, maar wel de
            // commentbuffer leegmaken zodat die niet aan de volgende hotkey
            // wordt geplakt.
            comments = []
            i++
            continue
        }

        // Hotkey, inclusief \ -continuties.
        var hotkey = String(line).trim()
        while (hotkey.charAt(hotkey.length - 1) === "\\"
                && i + 1 < lines.length) {
            hotkey = hotkey.substring(0, hotkey.length - 1).trim()
                + " " + String(lines[i + 1]).trim()
            i++
        }

        const commandInfo = readCommands(lines, i + 1)
        const description = comments.join(" ")
        const meta = pendingMeta
        comments = []
        pendingMeta = null

        if (commandInfo.commands.length > 0) {
            const commandText = commandInfo.commands.join("\n")
            const expanded = expandEntry(hotkey, commandText, section,
                description, i + 1, meta)
            for (var e = 0; e < expanded.length; e++)
                entries.push(expanded[e])
        }

        i = commandInfo.next
    }

    for (var g = 0; g < entries.length; g++) {
        if (groups.indexOf(entries[g].group) < 0)
            groups.push(entries[g].group)
    }

    return {
        entries: entries,
        groups: groups,
        sections: groups,
        error: ""
    }
}

function parse(text) {
    return parseResult(text).entries
}

// Filtert op zoektekst en groep. Een lege groep betekent "alle groepen".
function filter(entries, query, group) {
    const needle = String(query === null || query === undefined
        ? "" : query).trim().toLowerCase()
    const wanted = String(group === null || group === undefined
        ? "" : group)
    const result = []

    for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        const entry = entries[i]
        if (wanted.length > 0 && entry.group !== wanted)
            continue
        if (needle.length > 0 && entry.search.indexOf(needle) < 0)
            continue
        result.push(entry)
    }

    return result
}

// Groepeert een gefilterde lijst in de vorm die de UI tekent.
function groupEntries(entries) {
    const result = []
    var currentName = ""
    var currentEntries = []

    for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) {
        const entry = entries[i]
        if (entry.group !== currentName) {
            if (currentEntries.length > 0)
                result.push({ name: currentName, entries: currentEntries })
            currentName = entry.group
            currentEntries = []
        }
        currentEntries.push(entry)
    }

    if (currentEntries.length > 0)
        result.push({ name: currentName, entries: currentEntries })

    return result
}
